dimensions.assessment: Applies locally within the City of Carlsbad, New Mexico, and affects parties interested in federal mineral leasing.
dimensions.evidence: located within the City of Carlsbad, New Mexico

dimensions.assessment: Enables mineral leasing where it was previously excluded, creating potential economic activity for landowners and lessees.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may lease deposits of the minerals described

dimensions.assessment: Potential leasing revenues and administrative costs, but no specific amounts are provided in the source text.
Overrides specific geographic and statutory leasing exclusions in the Mineral Leasing Act and Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands for a specific municipality.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding the exclusion in the first section of the Mineral Leasing Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanently alters mineral leasing authority for the specified location subject to local consent.

missing_information: Exact quantity, value, and type of mineral deposits available for lease.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill permits the leasing of certain mineral deposits located within the City of Carlsbad, New Mexico, subject to city consent, overriding certain statutory exclusions for incorporated municipalities.
